findings.evidence: Section variables are `{F : Type*} [FunLike F ℍ ℂ] {Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℤ)} {k : ℤ}` (line 93) — no form class on these three declarations. `qExpansionOrderAtCusp` and `orderOfVanishingAt` both take `ℍ → ℂ` (Order/AtCusp.lean:60, Order/OfVanishing.lean:52), and the sibling this theorem is paired against, `hasCauchyPV_fdBoundary_logDeriv`, is already stated for `{f : ℂ → ℂ}` (LogDerivPV.lean:59).
findings.fix: Replace `(f : F)` by `(g : ℍ → ℂ)` in all three, i.e. `theorem two_pi_I_mul_sum_windingNumber_mul_order_eq (g : ℍ → ℂ) {H : ℝ} {Sx T : Finset ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {ord : ℂ → ℤ} {k : ℤ} (hH : 1 ≤ H) (hpv : Contour.HasCauchyPVWith (fdBoundary H) 0 5 (logDeriv (g ∘ ofComplex)) Sx (… qExpansionOrderAtCusp 1 g …)) …`; the three call sites (427, 822) pass `⇑f` and are otherwise unchanged.
findings.issue: This PR strips `[SlashInvariantFormClass F Γ k]` from `two_pi_I_mul_sum_windingNumber_mul_order_eq` (298), `two_pi_I_mul_sum_windingNumber_mul_orderOfVanishingAt_eq` (324) and `sum_windingNumber_mul_orderOfVanishingAt_eq` (362) but keeps `f : F`. No structure on `F` survives: every occurrence is `⇑f`, and `k` is now a free implicit fixed by `hpv`. The bundling is dead weight that forces a caller holding a bare function (a quotient of forms, `Δ`, an `η`-power) to fabricate a `FunLike` wrapper.

findings.evidence: `tendsto_intervalIntegral_excised_logDeriv_fdBoundary_arc` is already general in the excision set (called as `… H S` at 188 and `… H _` at 278), and the fixed-ε layer already factors this way: `intervalIntegral_excised_logDeriv_fdBoundary_of_neg_conj_mem` (ExcisedAssembly.lean:77) is the general `Sx` lemma from which both assemblies (ExcisedAssembly.lean:137, 271) are derived in a few lines.

findings.issue: `hasCauchyPVWith_fdBoundary_logDeriv_arcSingularSet_union_verticalSingularSet` (245-278) and `eventually_intervalIntegral_union_excised_eq` (201-243) duplicate `hasCauchyPVWith_fdBoundary_logDeriv_comp_ofComplex` (153-188) and `eventually_intervalIntegral_excised_eq` (118-151) line for line — same `hside` block, same three `intervalIntegrable_excised_of_subset` arguments, same `hval` push_cast/ring and `Tendsto.congr'` skeleton — differing only in which fixed-ε assembly is invoked. The ε→0 step is excision-set-agnostic and is being proved twice for two special shapes.

findings.evidence: Each proof ends `rw [eq_of_re_of_norm h1 h2, coe_I]` / `rw [eq_of_re_of_norm h1 h2]` / `rw [eq_of_re_of_norm h1 h2, coe_vadd_one_ρ]`, and `UpperHalfPlane.eq_of_re_of_norm` concludes `τ = τ'` in `ℍ` (Mathlib/Analysis/Complex/UpperHalfPlane/Basic.lean:127-128).
findings.fix: State them at the natural level — `eq_I_of_re_eq_zero : p = UpperHalfPlane.I`, `eq_ρ_of_re : p = ρ`, `eq_vadd_one_ρ_of_re : p = (1 : ℝ) +ᵥ ρ` — since each proof is already `exact eq_of_re_of_norm h1 h2`; the two call sites (BoundaryPairing.lean:296, ValencePV.lean:544-545) then use `congrArg _ (…)` composed with `coe_I` / `coe_vadd_one_ρ`.
findings.issue: `coe_eq_I_of_re_eq_zero` (97), `coe_eq_ρ_of_re` (104) and `coe_eq_ρ_add_one_of_re` (111) are public API in the shared corner module but conclude only the coerced equality, discarding the `ℍ` equality their own proofs produce. A consumer wanting `p = ρ` (to rewrite an order, a membership, or a winding value at the point) has to re-derive it via `coe_injective`.

summary: Three level issues: the PV mid-layers now carry a bundled `f : F` with no class instance where a plain `ℍ → ℂ` is what is used; the ε→0 PV wrapper is duplicated verbatim for the two excision shapes instead of proved once for an arbitrary excision set; and the new public corner classifications in `Rho.lean` are stated at the coerced level though their proofs establish the stronger `ℍ` equality.
